usedFor: Calendly records the meeting; Gmail sends the email. A booking, reschedule or cancellation in Calendly can trigger “Send Email” in Gmail to confirm it or follow up.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly, then “Send Email” in Gmail
bestTemplate.why: It sends a tailored email the moment someone books, with subject, body, recipients and attachments you set, such as a prep checklist.

watchOut: “When a meeting is scheduled, rescheduled, or canceled” polls and covers three states, so one person can get several emails. On 50agents, an email that reaches someone outside waits for your approval.
